description: Jacob has TotalInvestment to invest. He has decided to invest in his favorite clothing company and his favorite tech company. He has decided that the money invested in his favorite clothing company must be at least ClothingToTechRatio times as much as the amount invested in his favorite tech company. He has also limited himself to invest at most MaxTechInvestment in his favorite tech company. If the money invested in his favorite clothing company earns ClothingInterestRate and the money invested in his favorite tech company earns TechInterestRate, how much should he invest in each to maximize his profit?

TotalInvestment.definition: Total amount of money available to invest

ClothingToTechRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of clothing investment to tech investment

MaxTechInvestment.definition: Maximum investment allowed in tech company

ClothingInterestRate.definition: Interest rate earned from clothing company investment

TechInterestRate.definition: Interest rate earned from tech company investment

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit (total interest earned) from investments in the clothing and tech companies"

ClothingInvestment.definition: Amount of money invested in the clothing company

TechInvestment.definition: Amount of money invested in the tech company
